prompt: Reference images 1-2 show only the drawing style: take from them the line work, shading and simplicity, never their content, characters or colour scheme (the colours come from the palette below). Reference image 3 is the main character: keep exactly its head, face, colors, markings, body proportions; change only pose, action and expression. Its ear on the viewer's left is folded down and its ear on the viewer's right stands up, exactly as in the reference image, whichever way it turns; when the character is seen from behind, the folded ear is on the viewer's right. SCENE: tall vertical picture made of two equal panels one above the other with a plain gap between them, the same plain bedroom in both. TOP PANEL: late night in deep blue-grey shadow, a thin crescent moon in a small window: the main character sits up in bed wide awake, eyes wide and glassy, holding one phone up in both front paws so that we see the black back of the phone with its camera block, its face lit by the glow of the screen. BOTTOM PANEL: bright midday, warm sunlight pours through the same window across the bed: the same character is fast asleep sprawled across the bed, paws spread, mouth open, the blanket kicked off. The flame on its tail is dim in both panels. LAYOUT: both panels the same size; the character whole in each panel; the window in the same place in both; the phone screen is blank; no letters or numbers anywhere. Every phone in the picture is the same modern smartphone drawn correctly: a black iPhone 14 Pro with a thin black frame and rounded corners; from the back a plain matte black back with one square camera block in the upper corner holding three round lenses, no logo; from the front one blank glowing screen with a small pill cutout at the top; normal proportions, held naturally, never bent, doubled, cut or melted into a paw. If the picture has no specific place, its background is plain near-white paper, even and untinted, even if the reference images use a darker or coloured paper; a specific place is drawn as that place, with the paper showing around it. Colours: black ink lines and soft grey washes on plain cream paper, like the style reference. Soft watercolour colour goes only on one or two things that matter in the picture, the main object and maybe one detail, each in its own natural muted colour (blue water, a green plant, a pink cushion, a red heart, a yellow lamp light), and not everything in the same orange; furniture, clothes, walls, floors and everything else stay ink and light grey. Some of the things are coloured, never all of them. The background always stays the plain cream paper, never a coloured wall or a tinted background. Never neon, never harsh. The main character stays black with green eyes, orange cheek marks and an orange tail flame.. Every surface is clean and unmarked: blank paper, blank screens, plain envelopes, plain walls, unprinted floor. Keep the main subject well inside the frame, away from the edges. Draw everything in exactly the drawing style of the style references.
